name: Old Dominion Freight Line

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (File:Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. Logo.png)

description: Old Dominion is a less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier: it picks up partial truckloads from many shippers, consolidates them through a network of 260 service centers, and delivers them on its own trucks. Over 98 percent of revenue is LTL freight, priced per shipment by weight, class, distance and service, plus a fuel surcharge indexed to U.S. DOE diesel prices. Demand tracks industrial production and the U.S. domestic economy. FY2025 operating ratio was 75.2 percent (24.8 percent operating margin).

employees.note: Active full-time employees; none under collective bargaining.

businessLines.name: LTL services
businessLines.how: Shippers pay per shipment, priced on weight, freight class, lanes and service, plus a weekly-reset fuel surcharge; revenue = shipments x weight x price per hundredweight.

businessLines.name: Other services
businessLines.how: Container drayage, truckload brokerage and supply chain consulting sold as add-ons to LTL customers.
